definitions.supplemental: cumbol I. an ensign, banner; gehnást a conflict
definitions.meaning: A conflict of ensigns or banners, a battle

quotations.old_english: Ðæt hie beadoweorca beteran wurdon on campstede, cumbolgehnástes
quotations.english: that they were better in works of war on the battle-field, at the conflict of banners

source_text: cumbol-gehnást, es; n. [cumbol I. an ensign, banner; gehnást a conflict] A conflict of ensigns or banners, a battle; signorum conflictio, bellum :-- Ðæt hie beadoweorca beteran wurdon on campstede, cumbolgehnástes that they were better in works of war on the battle-field, at the conflict of banners, Chr. 937; Th. 206, 2, col. 2; 207, 2.
